FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Harvest Market
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspections Coordinator, Fresh Harvest Market, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@freshharvestmarket.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fresh Harvest Market specializes in the retail sale of fresh fruits and vegetables, offering a wide selection of locally sourced and organic produce. Our operations emphasize quality standards, including comprehensive staff training in handling protocols, ensuring that our team is well-equipped to maintain product integrity. We maintain temperature and humidity controls for all perishable items to prevent spoilage and uphold the highest product quality. Supplier audits are conducted regularly to ensure that all products meet compliance standards. Additionally, we utilize a digital inventory management system that provides real-time alerts for temperature fluctuations, enhancing our loss prevention efforts. Our market operates in compliance with all local health department regulations and maintains current certifications to guarantee a safe shopping experience for our customers. We pride ourselves on fostering community engagement through participation in local initiatives, further reinforcing our commitment to quality.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Dates: 08/01/2023; Cause: Refrigeration unit failure due to a power outage leading to spoilage of perishable inventory; Amount: $2,500; Status: Resolved. Loss Dates: 09/15/2023; Cause: Minor theft of produce during market hours; Amount: $1,000; Status: Pending investigation.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Reinforced steel vault with UL Class 1 rating for cash and valuables storage, compliant with security regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Installation of a security fence around the perimeter, along with on-site watchpersons during operating hours for enhanced protection against theft and vandalism.
